subject: Red Team / Annual AppSec Pen Test — scope & quote review
messages:
From: Jordan Fields <jordan@redteamsecure.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@redteamsecure.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal & SOW for annual red team / appsec testing

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, attached is our proposed SOW for Redwood Inference's annual red team and web application penetration test. High-level summary: 
- Duration: 3 weeks of active testing + 1 week reporting
- Scope: web app (production), internal auth flows, API endpoints listed in pen-test-scope.xlsx
- Deliverables: Technical report, executive summary, reproduceable findings, remediation guidance, and a 1-hour findings walkthrough
- Price: $85,000 flat-fee (includes retest of critical fixes within 30 days)

Attachments: RedTeam_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 342KB); pen-test-scope.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

If this looks good we can provide a redlined SOW and send the DocuSign link. We aim to start the engagement the week of Apr 12 to align with your release freeze window.

Open items for you:
- Confirm final scope (are there additional internal services to include?)
- Procurement: will Redwood need vendor questionnaire / PO?
- Any org conflicts for April start?

Happy to set a quick 30-min call to walk through.

Best,
Jordan Fields
Principal Consultant | RedTeam Secure
jordan@redteamsecure.com | +1 (415) 555-0119

--
RedTeam Secure | Practical adversary simulation for product teams

Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal & SOW for annual red team / appsec testing

Jordan —

Thanks for the SOW and scope spreadsheet. Quick notes after a first pass: 
1) Scope: please add our internal admin tooling (admin.redwoodinference.com) — it stores PII and should be included in the auth flow review.
2) Timing: Apr 12 start looks ok but Marcus flagged potential calendar conflicts Apr 19–23 (team offsite). Can you do Apr 5 start instead?
3) Price: $85k is within range but procurement will likely push for a 60–90 day payment term; will RedTeam accept Net-60?
4) Compliance paperwork: we need your SOC2 attestation and cyber insurance details before PO.

Marcus / Laura — looping you for procurement and security sign-off. Marcus: can you confirm budget cadence (one-time vs. renewed as part of security ops budget)? Laura: can you confirm the compliance artefacts we need?

Naomi
